_how_to_add: To add a review, copy the example block below into the list called reviews and fill it in. Put a comma between reviews. id must be a different number or word for every review and must never change once you have added it. productSlug must match the kit's slug exactly: halal-nails-pink-neutrals, halal-nails-cool-neutrals or halal-nails-berries. rating is a whole number from 1 to 5. date is year-month-day. text is required for Google's review feed, so always include the customer's words. reply is optional: your public response, shown under the review on the page. media is optional: the customer's photos or videos, shown under their review (two or more become a carousel). Each item is { "type": "image" or "video", "url": file name, "alt": optional description, "poster": optional still picture for a video }. Photos go in public/images/reviews/ and videos in public/videos/reviews/, and the url is written as reviews/file-name. Only reviews inside the reviews list are used; this example is ignored. Add every review, including low ratings.
